notes: «حدثنا بذلك، إسحاق بن منصور» gives the compiler's own shaykh: the main chain starts there
«وقد روي هذا الحديث ... مرسل» is another route for the same saying without the Muawiya and Ala' links: a variant group (rule 4), not a route
«قال قال النبي» ends the chain at Jubayr; the Prophet is not a link (rule 12)
